notes.title: Introducing: Items for towers | Demo Version 1.1
notes.content:
Changelog

 MAJOR FEATURE: All relic items can now be placed in towers to function the same way they do in players, adding thousands of upgrades and interactions to discover
 Further improved tutorial experience
 Bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Added a main menu
 Added a soundtrack
 Updated room door visuals for more clarity
 Improved some UI elements
 Tutorial improved once again
 Tweaks to sound effects
 Bugfixes

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Added option to infinitely repeat floors in the demo to keep playing
 Improved tutorial
 Added option for fullscreen, defaults to fullscreen on
 Tweaked room difficulty and made player start with more health

notes.title: Knightward - State of Development
notes.content:
Happy new year! It's been a long journey but we are finally nearing release. Here's some new features you can be looking forward to:

 A playable demo is coming to Steam very soon!
 ESSENCE: This currency persists between runs and will be able to be used for cosmetics and unlocking  new items
 ...and more. New content is being added everyday. Experience new enemies, items, and environments.

I hope you are all as excited I am to see Knightward take shape. Thank you to everyone for all your support.
